name: blux-ui-build
description: Builds the generated assets of Blux.UI. Only needed to work on the library, never by apps using it.

scripts.classes:tools: dotnet build src/Blux.UI.Tools -c Debug --nologo -v q && dotnet run --project build/Blux.UI.ClassExtractor -- src/Blux.UI.Tools --assembly src/Blux.UI.Tools/bin/Debug/net10.0/Blux.UI.Tools.dll --extension Blux.UI.Tools.BluxToolsOptions --only-extensions --theme-css blux-tools.theme.css
scripts.css: tailwindcss -i src/Blux.UI/styles/blux.css -o src/Blux.UI/wwwroot/blux.css --minify && tailwindcss -i src/Blux.UI/styles/blux.preflight.css -o src/Blux.UI/wwwroot/blux.preflight.css --minify
scripts.build: npm run icons && npm run classes && npm run css && npm run js && npm run editor && npm run classes:tools && npm run css:tools && npm run js:tools && npm run site:css
